question: Should Mercado Pago refunds be operated by a Hamelyn flow that calls Mercado Pago and then reports the refund to Stripe, or should Mercado Pago checkout be migrated so Stripe processes and refunds the payment end to end?
rationale: Current code proves Stripe is only a reporting surface for these payments, so the implementation depends on whether maintainers want Stripe visibility or Stripe to become the payment processor/refund executor.

options.title: Add Hamelyn refund action
options.body: Implement a backoffice refund flow that executes the refund in Mercado Pago and records the refund result in Stripe for reconciliation.

options.title: Migrate to Stripe-native processing
options.body: Rework the payment method so Stripe creates the charge and can execute refunds directly, if the product and provider constraints allow it.

options.title: Keep Mercado Pago manual refunds
options.body: Keep Stripe as visibility-only and continue operating refunds directly in Mercado Pago or Meli.

recommendation.title: Add Hamelyn refund action
recommendation.body: Implement a backoffice refund flow that executes the refund in Mercado Pago and records the refund result in Stripe for reconciliation.

likelyOwner.reason: JavierHamelyn has the strongest current history on the Mercado Pago checkout and Stripe payment-record integration.
